finalText:
All 625 cases pass and `verify.js` confirms the fix is legitimate.

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` was computing tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, contradicting the rule that "tax is charged on the amount the customer pays." Changed `roundCents(cents * taxRate)` to `roundCents(discounted * taxRate)` — a one-line fix, no test or spec changes.
